layout_contract.notes: Coordinates are authoring proposals in page CSS pixels. See render-geometry.json for actual measured bounds. 44/46/48px buttons and 56px marks are chosen here, not a universal WCAG requirement.

states.input_focus: 3px visible outline with 3px offset; follows native keyboard focus. Does not imply selection.
states.pressed: 1px downward transform while actively pressed; hitbox retains layout bounds. Suppressed with reduced motion.
states.hover: Enabled controls only; changes face or rim without rearranging siblings.
states.destructive: Reset current genre clears that local fixture and history. No account, economy, item sale or hold-to-confirm action.
states.error: Concrete blocked reason and reachable correction; no network failure simulation.

presets.back_cancel_escape: Return/Escape closes inventory and focuses Inventory. Equipment remains committed; selected candidate remains available on reopening.

blocked_error_recovery.visible: Requires rank 3. Choose an available blade.

roles.selected: Candidate item face + Selected text + aria-pressed
roles.disabled: Fill #35413c, label #b8bdb0 and nearby blocked reason
roles.pressed: 1px transient offset; no committed selection implication

ai_instructions: Build camp and inventory as separate states. Do not add shopping, currency, quest panels or an equip confirmation.
Use exact item fixture: Reed power 8 guard 2 rank 1; Brass power 12 guard 1 rank 2; Anchor power 18 guard 5 rank 3. Player rank remains 2.
Compare current and candidate in matching columns. Show signed deltas for Power and Guard even when zero.
Selecting changes only candidate. Equip changes only equipped ID; repeated equip cannot consume an item or duplicate a result.
Use brass only for primary equipment actions and stat deltas. Keep requirements in written text beside Equip. Return to camp must show equipped values.
gates: Open→select→equip→Return→reopen retains equipment and candidate
Unavailable item never equips
Selecting does not change equipped ID
Repeated equip is idempotent
Escape restores Inventory focus; reset restores rank/item fixture

presets.title: Glass sentinel
presets.back_cancel_escape: Escape clears selection only. No turn or card is consumed. Gallery switching retains duel state.

blocked_error_recovery.visible: Needs 4 energy. Use Focus or choose another card.
blocked_error_recovery.recovery: Play Focus to gain 1 energy, then select Burst
Select another card or End turn

hierarchy: Both health values, shield, energy and next attack
presets.world_context: Dark plum table with pale paper card faces keeps the local duel and readable card costs central. A geometric glass sigil is an authored symbol, not game art. Card selection border differs from the cyan focus ring.

roles.primary: Play selected card, replaced by Retry duel after result
roles.selected: Gold card boundary, Selected text and aria-pressed
roles.cooldown: Not applicable; played-this-turn lock uses dashed face and written state
roles.disabled: Fill #453e54, label #c6bdcd and nearby blocked reason
roles.pressed: 1px transient offset; no committed selection implication

ai_instructions: Use Cut cost 2 damage 6, Guard cost 1 shield 4, Focus cost 0 energy +1, Burst cost 4 damage 10. These are synthetic rules, not balance claims.
Selection spends nothing. Play spends cost once, applies effect once and adds one used ID. Do not implement drag-only card play.
End turn applies max(0,3-shield) damage, clears shield, restores energy to 3 and resets used cards only when health remains above zero.
Keep card cost, effect, health, energy and next attack visible before committing. Retain played cards as inspectable faces marked Played this turn.
End result replaces Play with Retry; retry returns exact initial state. Do not invent network readiness or hidden opponent resources.
gates: Selection changes no resources
Focus then Burst consumes exactly 4 energy and deals 10 damage
Played card cannot resolve twice
Guard absorbs exactly the next attack up to its shield
Loss/win blocks further resolution; retry restores fixture

presets.back_cancel_escape: No stacked gameplay menu; gallery switches retain board/history. Undo reverses one committed move. Escape has no puzzle binding.

blocked_error_recovery.when: Movement or push enters a wall
blocked_error_recovery.visible: Blocked by a wall / crate cannot move into a wall

presets.world_context: Warm paper floor, dark masonry edges, round blue player and square clay crate make collision roles distinct by silhouette. Soft corners apply to controls, while board geometry stays exact.

narrow.board_position: Above directional controls; Undo/Retry beside controls

roles.primary: Retry room; movement is the main repeated action via dpad/keys
roles.selected: Not applicable to board; current player uses circle and coordinate state
roles.disabled: Fill #ece5da, label #666259 and nearby blocked reason
roles.pressed: 1px transient offset; no committed selection implication

ai_instructions: Build a 6×6 board with boundary walls, one internal wall at 2,2, player 1,3, crate 2,3 and target 4,2; coordinates are zero based.
Commit a history snapshot only for valid movement. A blocked move cannot change player, crate or count.
Push only if the next crate cell is free. Do not let player or crate pass through a wall.
Undo restores both positions, count and solved state. Retry clears all history and restores the fixture.
Keep directional buttons and Undo/Retry visible below or beside the board at narrow width. Show target using dashed shape, not hue alone.
gates: Right Right Down Right Up solves naturally in 5 moves
Blocked move changes no positions/count/history
Undo after solve restores unsolved board and count 4
Retry restores board and clears undo history
Keyboard and visible dpad produce identical transitions

presets.back_cancel_escape: Escape/Cancel discards preview, preserves selection and last committed order. Focus returns to selected unit if Confirm/Cancel becomes disabled.

blocked_error_recovery.visible: Select a unit before choosing a target.
Water is blocked. Choose open ground.

presets.world_context: Olive field map, squared beveled controls and compact inspector support spatial targeting. Gold dashed previews and solid committed lines express distinct command boundaries; focus remains blue.

narrow.inspector_position: Below map; full selection/target rows; paired Confirm/Cancel

roles.secondary: Cancel preview; map and unit targets
roles.selected: Unit inset border + inspector unit name + aria-pressed
roles.disabled: Fill #3d443d, label #b3bbaa and nearby blocked reason
roles.pressed: 1px transient offset; no committed selection implication

ai_instructions: Use the original 9×5 fixed map and exact unit/water fixture. Commands record orders; units do not animate or move.
Selection issues no order. Clicking open ground with selection creates only a pending target. Water clears pending target and explains recovery.
Dashed line and Preview label represent pending command. Solid line and Last order text represent committed command.
Confirm appends exactly one local order count and clears pending target. Cancel preserves prior order and selected unit.
Keep HUD outside map hitboxes and svg vectors pointer-events:none. Browser Tab traverses native map cells without controller wrap behavior.
gates: Selection and preview do not increment orders
Water cannot commit and clears stale preview
Cancel preserves unit and last committed target
Confirm once records exactly one order and clears preview
HUD clicks never become world targets; disabled footer action restores unit focus

presets.back_cancel_escape: Pause/Escape opens native modal. Resume/Escape closes it and restores Pause focus. Gallery switching freezes cooldown for inactive action prototype.

blocked_error_recovery.recovery: Health decrements by 1; move from entry
Move within pulse range and clear sentries

blocked_error_recovery.visible: Run lost. Retry to start again.

presets.world_context: Compact cyan hardware HUD sits above a blue-black arena. Peach diamond sentries and striped hazards differ from circular player and barred gate. Local opaque backing preserves label contrast.

narrow.safe_area: All controls in document flow; outer env safe-area inset

roles.primary: Pulse, replaced by Retry run at result
roles.selected: No target selection; player is a persistent circular marker
roles.cooldown: Disabled Pulse with numeric seconds + fill bar; a 3000ms synthetic gameplay setting
roles.disabled: Fill #304552, label #bdcbd1 and nearby blocked reason
roles.pressed: 1px transient offset; no committed selection implication

shortcuts.Space: Pulse from arena focus; focused native buttons retain normal Space activation

ai_instructions: Use exact 11×7 fixture. Movement is one cell per accepted input. Sentries are static; do not invent chasers or difficulty claims.
Pulse clears sentries at Manhattan distance ≤3. An empty pulse still starts 3000ms cooldown. Cooldown ticks only in active visible unpaused action screen.
Pause uses a native modal, stops movement and cooldown, and returns focus to Pause on Resume/Escape. Retry resets health, positions, sentries, result and cooldown.
Collision decrements health once and returns player to entry. At zero health block further gameplay and expose Retry. Gate completes only when both sentries are cleared.
Keep mobile dpad, Pulse, Pause and retry visible with no HUD/world overlap. Do not claim native phone, controller, game timing accessibility or latency certification.
gates: Natural input path clears sentries and reaches gate
Pulse cannot resolve again during cooldown
Pause freezes both movement and cooldown; resume continues without time jump
Three sentry collisions produce loss; retry restores fixture
Cooldown freezes during gallery switch and document hidden; result blocks movement
